title: A table for friends
subtitle: Pick a game. Share a room. Make an evening of it.
name: Your name
uno_description: Color, chaos, and one last card. Our familiar stacking house rules.
catan_description: Build roads and settlements, trade resources, and grow your island empire.
disconnected: Reconnecting… Your seat is reserved temporarily.
waiting: The host can start once everyone has joined.
room_missing: This room may have ended. Rooms are lost when the server restarts.
storage_error: Your browser could not save the reconnect token. Keep this tab open.
uno_hint: Match color or symbol. Drawing ends your turn. +2 / +4 may stack; declare UNO before playing your second-last card.
catan_discard_instruction: Discard half your resources when you have more than seven.
catan_island_description: CATAN island. Use the location buttons below to build.
catan_building_costs: Costs: road = wood + brick; settlement = wood + brick + wool + wheat; city = 3 ore + 2 wheat; development = ore + wool + wheat.
catan_development_instruction: New cards wait until your next opportunity. One non-VP card per opportunity.
uno_declared_hint: Press UNO before playing your second-last card.
catan_help_text: Reach 10 points. Roll for resources, trade, then build roads, settlements and cities. Hover or keyboard-focus a legal location to see a translucent piece. Click to preview and confirm, or double-click to place it. Wheel zoom follows the mouse; pinch zoom follows the fingers. You can also use +/− buttons; 100% or Home resets the view. When zoomed in, drag the island or use arrow keys while the map is focused to pan. Harbor boats show the resource and exchange rate. In practice, click a player’s name to control their civilization.
catan_practice_error: That action is not legal now. Check the controlled seat and try again.
catan_hint_setup: Preview and confirm a settlement, then an adjacent road. Practice automatically switches to the next player. Click a player name to inspect another seat.
catan_hint_building: Upgrade a settlement to a city or extend a road. Watch the piece land.
catan_hint_production: Roll the dice to collect resources from producing tiles. End turns and switch seats to roll again.
catan_hint_robber: Move the robber beside an opponent’s building, then choose a victim.
catan_hint_monopoly: Open Development cards and choose a resource for Monopoly.
catan_hint_trading: Open Trading for a bank exchange, or offer resources, switch seats to accept, then return to confirm.
catan_hint_awards: Play your third Knight to claim Largest army. Then move the robber.
catan_hint_victory: You have nine points, including five hidden victory cards. Upgrade a city to win.
catan_charge_hint: Hold to charge your throw. Release to roll; maximum strength takes 3 seconds.
catan_auto_rotate: Automatically switch to the next player
catan_open_offer_help: Offer resources to the table. Interested players can accept; you choose one to trade with.
catan_trade_turn_reason: Trades must involve {player}, whose turn it is.
catan_trade_wait_reason: Trading opens after the dice roll, once robber actions are resolved.
catan_offer_resources_reason: Choose resources you own to give and different resources to receive.
catan_no_offers: No offers yet. Offers addressed to you or open to the table will appear here.
catan_bank_help: Trade with the supply, without another player. Available exchanges use your best port rate, or 4:1.
catan_no_bank_trades: No bank exchanges available. You need enough matching resources and it must be your trading opportunity.
catan_trade_no_resources: You need at least one resource to offer.
catan_offer_sent: Offer sent. You can follow responses here.
